description: HORA is Austria's public natural hazard overview and risk assessment map, published by the federal ministry responsible for agriculture, climate and water management and operated by its data centre LFRZ. The viewer read on 2026-09-28 gives first information on hazards from floods, earthquakes, storms, hail and snow, including a flood risk zoning layer, together with current warnings for floods, hail, heavy rain and earthquakes; base data carry a reference date of 1 April 2025. Coverage is Austria. Access is free to view, but the legal notes prohibit downloading data from the site and its underlying map services and databases, except content expressly offered for download. Caveats: the maps are not official information, an area not shown as flood-prone may still flood, and recently built flood defences are not always represented. It supports hazard exposure screening, such as checking whether a substation or school lies in a flood risk or high snow zone before requesting official data from the province. No related Austrian hazard map record is catalogued.
